headline: European Natural Gas Benchmark Opens 1.9% Higher at €82.30/MWh
summary: European natural gas futures opened 1.9% higher at €82.30 per megawatt-hour on the TTF exchange in Amsterdam as energy market volatility persisted.
why: Title Transfer Facility (TTF) gas futures serve as the primary wholesale pricing benchmark for natural gas across Europe.

impacts.name: TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Wholesale natural gas contracts opened 1.9% higher in Amsterdam trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Supply disruption risks in international gas markets supported higher opening bids.
